arc.grandline.recruit_hint.aria: Aria will join your crew if you ask: talk to her and invite her aboard.
arc.grandline.recruit_hint.gunnar: Gunnar will join your crew if you ask: talk to him and invite him aboard.
arc.grandline.recruit_hint.kanna: Kanna will join your crew if you ask: talk to her and invite her aboard.
arc.grandline.recruit_hint.nimbus: Nimbus will join your crew if you ask: talk to her and invite her aboard.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.why: Everyone in lawless Jaya owes Usurio 'the Debt Collector' Shakkin — the bars, the crews, and Aria Fuusen, the Sky People girl who fell from the clouds at six and has been building balloons to fly home ever since. Shakkin means to take her workshop, her balloon and her.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.cast.aria: Aria 'Skylark' Fuusen of the Sky People: fell from a sky island as a child, builds balloons to get home, can spot a gull at three miles.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.cast.felicity: Felicity 'Grand Larceny' Nekomata, a rival Supernova and a cat Mink who steals from everyone — mostly from people who deserve it.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.cast.usurio: Usurio 'the Debt Collector' Shakkin, loan shark. Owns every bar in Jaya, and everyone in them.
arc.grandline.decision.jaya_plan: what to do with Shakkin's ledgers (talk to Felicity)
arc.grandline.site.jaya_workshop: Aria's balloon workshop by the Knock Up marker
arc.grandline.site.jaya_ledger_vault: the ledger vault under the counting house
quest.grandline.jaya_collectors.desc: Shakkin's collectors have come for Aria's workshop with crowbars and a bill. Drive off 5 of them.
quest.grandline.jaya_felicity.desc: The cat who has been robbing Shakkin's collectors wants a word. Talk to Felicity Nekomata.
quest.grandline.jaya_envelope.desc: Shakkin's men took Aria's balloon envelope as 'collateral'. Get it back from the counting house: beat 4 of his men.
quest.grandline.jaya_choice.desc: Felicity knows where every ledger in Jaya is kept. Burn them all, or let her steal them? Talk to Felicity and decide.
quest.grandline.jaya_bonfire.desc: Break into the ledger vault under the counting house: beat the 3 men guarding it, and burn every debt in Jaya.
quest.grandline.jaya_heist.desc: Make a great deal of noise at the counting house's back door while Felicity robs the vault: get there.
scene.grandline.jaya_1.end.1: narrator|Jaya: a pirate town of bars, bets and bullet holes. Every sign on the main street has a second, smaller sign under it: PROPERTY OF U. SHAKKIN.
scene.grandline.jaya_1.end.2: narrator|On the coast past the town, by a stone marker scorched black by something huge, a girl is sewing a balloon the size of a house.
scene.grandline.jaya_1.end.3: aria|Oh! A ship! A real one, with real sails — sorry. Aria. Aria Fuusen. I'm from up there. No, really: up THERE. I fell when I was six.
scene.grandline.jaya_1.end.4: aria|Every year the Knock Up Stream blows right here, straight up through the clouds. If the balloon's ready when it blows, I'm home. It blows in three days.
scene.grandline.jaya_1.end.5: aria|...And Mister Shakkin's collectors come in an hour. Please tell me you can fight.
scene.grandline.jaya_collectors.start.1: pirate|Collection day, sky girl! The workshop, the balloon, the lot — or the interest, which is the workshop, the balloon and the lot!
scene.grandline.jaya_collectors.end.1: narrator|The collectors run back up the road clutching their crowbars. One drops his bill: ARIA FUUSEN — PRINCIPAL 2,000 — INTEREST 9,000,000 BELI.
scene.grandline.jaya_collectors.end.2: aria|Nine million. I borrowed two thousand for silk when I was six. I didn't even borrow it — Mister Shakkin said my signature was 'adorable'.
scene.grandline.jaya_collectors.end.3: narrator|A shape drops off the workshop roof and lands without a sound: a cat Mink with a leopard's tail and somebody's purse in each hand.
scene.grandline.jaya_felicity.end.1: felicity|Nyahaha. Don't check your pockets, it's rude. Felicity Nekomata. Grand Larceny. I've been robbing Shakkin's collectors for a week, and I am SO bored of small change.
scene.grandline.jaya_felicity.end.2: felicity|Here's something you'll like: he keeps every debt in Jaya in ledgers under his counting house. The bars, the crews, the sky girl. Without the books, nobody owes him a single Beli.
scene.grandline.jaya_felicity.end.3: felicity|And here's something you won't: while you were busy out here, his men took her balloon envelope as 'collateral'. No envelope, no flight. The stream blows in three days.
scene.grandline.jaya_felicity.end.4: aria|They took the — I sewed that for nine YEARS!
scene.grandline.jaya_envelope.start.1: aria|Counting house. Big building, small windows, smells like money. I'll be right behind you. A long way behind you.
scene.grandline.jaya_envelope.end.1: narrator|Shakkin's men go down among the strongboxes. The envelope is rolled up in a corner, tagged LOT 1 — SKY GIRL'S SILK — AUCTION AT DAWN.
scene.grandline.jaya_envelope.end.2: aria|It's all right. It's all right. Not a hole in it. ...Well, one, but that one's mine.
scene.grandline.jaya_envelope.end.3: felicity|Psst. Now that you've kicked the front door in — the ledger vault is right under our feet. I have an idea. You won't like it. I have another idea. You'll like that one less.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.talk.1: felicity|Idea one: we go down there and burn every ledger in Jaya. Every debt in town, gone in one bonfire. The bars cheer. Shakkin cries. I get nothing, which is a tragedy.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.talk.2: felicity|Idea two: you go in the back door and make a lot of noise while I take the books. I keep them. You get a cut — a big one — and I fight beside you when Shakkin comes.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.talk.3: aria|If she keeps them, everyone in town still owes. Just to a cat.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.talk.4: felicity|To a NICE cat. I'd only collect from people who deserve it. Everyone deserves it a little.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.talk.5: aria|...It's your call. You're the one he'll come for.
scene.grandline.choice.jaya_plan.burn: Burn every ledger in Jaya. Nobody owes anybody.
scene.grandline.choice.jaya_plan.deal: Let Felicity steal the books, for her help and a cut.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.end.burn.1: felicity|Boring. Noble. Boring. ...Fine. Don't expect me at the fight; I've got pockets to pick.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.end.burn.2: aria|The vault's guarded. Three of them. I'll bring matches.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.end.deal.1: felicity|Nyahaha! A captain with sense. Back door, five minutes, lots of noise. I'll find you when it gets interesting.
scene.grandline.jaya_choice.end.deal.2: aria|...I'll pretend I didn't hear the 'nice cat' part.
scene.grandline.jaya_bonfire.end.1: narrator|The vault guards go down. Aria strikes a match, and a hundred years of debt goes up in a column of smoke the whole town comes out to watch.
scene.grandline.jaya_bonfire.end.2: resident|My bar! It's MY bar again! Drinks on — no, drinks are still for sale. But cheaper!
scene.grandline.jaya_heist.end.1: narrator|You kick the back door in loudly enough to wake the dead. Somewhere below you, very quietly, a cat is filling a sack with ledgers.
scene.grandline.jaya_heist.end.2: felicity|Got them. Every single one. Now let's go and be rude to their owner.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.start.1: usurio|You've been very expensive today. Interest is due. Hourly, for you.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.start.burn.1: usurio|My BOOKS. Do you know what you've burned? A hundred years of other people's money!
scene.grandline.jaya_2.start.deal.1: usurio|Where are my ledgers? Who has my — the CAT. Of course it's the cat.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.start.deal.2: felicity|Nyahaha. Hello, Mister Shakkin. I'm your new bookkeeper.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.end.1: narrator|The Debt Collector goes down on his own front step. Up and down the main street, people stop to stare.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.end.burn.1: narrator|The Debt Collector goes down on his own front step. Up and down the main street, people are taking down the little signs that said PROPERTY OF U. SHAKKIN.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.end.burn.2: aria|Nobody owes him anything. Not the bars, not the crews. Not me.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.end.deal.1: narrator|The Debt Collector goes down on his own front step. Felicity steps over him with a sack of ledgers on her shoulder and tosses you a fat purse and an Impact Dial.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.end.deal.2: felicity|Your cut, partner. Don't spend it all on one sky girl. See you at Sabaody — I'll be the one with the better bounty.
scene.grandline.jaya_2.end.deal.3: aria|...Everyone still owes. Just to her, now.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.start.1: narrator|The Knock Up Stream is due at noon. By the scorched marker, Aria's balloon is fat with hot air and straining at its ropes.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.1: aria|It's ready. It's actually ready. ...And I've been thinking. I've spent nine years looking UP.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.2: aria|What if home can wait one more year? There are islands down here I've never seen. You'd need a lookout. I can see a gull at three miles. I can see your next storm before it's a cloud.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.3: aria|Ask me. And if you want to see the White Sea first, the stream blows at noon — ride it. The Log Pose points to Long Ring Long Land either way.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.burn.1: aria|The whole town's free. Even me. And the first thing I did with my freedom was decide to miss my flight. Isn't that strange?
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.burn.2: aria|There are islands down here I've never seen. You'd need a lookout. I can see a gull at three miles. I can see your next storm before it's a cloud.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.burn.3: aria|Ask me. And if you want to see the White Sea first, the stream blows at noon — ride it. The Log Pose points to Long Ring Long Land either way.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.deal.1: aria|I don't owe Shakkin any more. I owe a cat, who says she's 'forgiven it for now'. I'd rather not be here when 'now' runs out.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.deal.2: aria|There are islands down here I've never seen. You'd need a lookout. I can see a gull at three miles. I can see your next storm before it's a cloud.
scene.grandline.recruit_aria.end.deal.3: aria|Ask me. And if you want to see the White Sea first, the stream blows at noon — ride it. The Log Pose points to Long Ring Long Land either way.
recap.grandline.jaya_1: Reached Jaya, where everyone owes the Debt Collector, and met Aria Fuusen, a Sky People girl building a balloon to fly home.
recap.grandline.jaya_collectors: Drove Shakkin's collectors off Aria's workshop: two thousand Beli borrowed at six is nine million now.
recap.grandline.jaya_felicity: Met Felicity Nekomata, a thief with a tip: every debt in Jaya is kept in ledgers under the counting house.
recap.grandline.jaya_envelope: Took Aria's balloon envelope back from the counting house before it went to auction.
recap.grandline.jaya_choice.burn: Decided to burn every ledger in Jaya.
recap.grandline.jaya_choice.deal: Decided to let Felicity steal the ledgers, for her help and a cut.
recap.grandline.jaya_bonfire: Burned a hundred years of debt in the ledger vault while the town watched.
recap.grandline.jaya_heist: Made a great deal of noise at the back door while Felicity emptied the vault.
recap.grandline.jaya_2.burn: Brought down the Debt Collector. Nobody in Jaya owes him anything any more.
recap.grandline.jaya_2.deal: Brought down the Debt Collector with Felicity at your side; she kept the books and paid your cut.
recap.grandline.recruit_aria: Aria chose the sea over the sky, for now: she'll be your lookout if you ask. The Log Pose points to Long Ring Long Land.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.bonus.burn: Jaya's bars stand you a round wherever you go: the whole town knows who burned the books. Jaya's shops give you 15% off from now on.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.bonus.deal: Felicity's cut: a fat purse of Shakkin's money, and an Impact Dial 'from his desk drawer'.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.aid.burn: The freed debtors pour out of the bars and pelt Shakkin's gunmen with bottles. Fewer bullets come your way.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.aid.deal: A leopard's shadow flickers behind Shakkin's men. Felicity's claws open the way, and you hit harder for it.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.during.aria: Three days till the stream. Two and a half. I count in my sleep.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.during.felici: Nyahaha. Still deciding whether to trust me? Good instinct. Wrong answer, but good instinct.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.after.aria: The balloon's packed in a hold somewhere. Someday. Not today.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.after.aria.bu: Nobody owes anybody in Jaya. I walked down the main street twice just to feel it.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.after.aria.de: Felicity's 'collecting' politely, at least. Mostly. I still think we should have burned them.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.after.felicit: Nyahaha. Partner! Or rival. Depends what's in your pockets.
All that paper, up in smoke. I'll never forgive you. I'll see you at Sabaody anyway.
Business is wonderful. Everyone pays a cat on time. Want a loan? Kidding. Mostly.
arc.grandline.debt_and_sky.after.townsfo: Shakkin's gone. Funny how the beer tastes better.
They burned the books! I don't owe a single Beli! I'm buying — no, YOU'RE buying, but it's cheaper now!
Now I owe a cat. She's politer than Shakkin. She's also always on my roof.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.why: The nomads of Long Ring Long Land settle everything with the Tug-of-Tides: three rounds, crew against crew, and the loser gives up their flag. Ayame 'Thousand Knots' Musubi has won three years running — and now she has challenged you.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.cast.gunnar: Gunnar 'Mossback' Iwakoke, a Stonehide wrestler and the nomads' champion. Sworn to guard whoever holds the Long Ring flag, and very tired of guarding Ayame.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.cast.ayame: Ayame 'Thousand Knots' Musubi, a rival Supernova with a whip and a gift for knots; holds the Long Ring flag. Believes rules are just knots somebody else tied.
arc.grandline.decision.ring_plan: what to do about the stake (talk to Gunnar)
arc.grandline.site.ring_stake: the stake under the rope line
quest.grandline.ring_round1.desc: First round: everybody into the field, last crew standing. Knock 4 of Ayame's crew out of it.
quest.grandline.ring_knots.desc: You pulled with everything you had and the rope didn't move an inch. Find out what it's tied to: the line runs past Ayame's camp.
quest.grandline.ring_pledge.desc: One round each. Ayame has announced the final round — and raised the stakes. Talk to Gunnar.
quest.grandline.ring_choice.desc: You know about the stake. Expose it in front of the whole camp, or quietly make sure it can't hold? Talk to Gunnar and decide.
quest.grandline.ring_expose.desc: The Tide Judge has voided her old wins, and Ayame's crew has stormed the field. Beat 3 of them.
quest.grandline.ring_quiet.desc: Keep watch at the stake while Gunnar pulls it out in the dark.
quest.grandline.ring_final.desc: The Knot Ring: one on one, for the flag. Defeat Ayame 'Thousand Knots' Musubi.
scene.grandline.ring_1.end.1: narrator|Long Ring Long Land: grass to the horizon on an island so long and thin you can see the sea on both sides. Tents, horses, and a crowd round a rope as thick as your arm.
scene.grandline.ring_1.end.2: tide_judge|Newcomers! Then you'll know the rule: here we settle things with the Tug-of-Tides. Three rounds, crew against crew. The loser hands the winner their flag.
scene.grandline.ring_1.end.3: ayame|Fresh flags! I have three already; a fourth would look lovely. I challenge your crew. You can say no — but then you hand me your flag anyway. Rules.
scene.grandline.ring_1.end.4: gunnar|Hm. I'm Gunnar. The island's champion. I'm sworn to guard whoever holds the Long Ring flag. She holds it. She has for three years.
scene.grandline.ring_1.end.5: gunnar|...I would like her to lose. Fairly.
scene.grandline.ring_round1.start.1: tide_judge|Round one: the Barrel Brawl! Into the field, everyone! Last crew standing takes the round!
scene.grandline.ring_round1.end.1: narrator|The last of Ayame's crew sails out of the field over a barrel. The crowd roars. One round to you.
scene.grandline.ring_round1.end.2: ayame|Lucky. Round two's the rope. Nobody has ever pulled me over the line. Nobody ever will.
scene.grandline.ring_knots.start.1: narrator|Round two. You dig in and pull with everything you have — and the rope doesn't move. Not an inch. Not even when Gunnar, watching from the side, frowns very hard at it.
scene.grandline.ring_knots.start.2: tide_judge|Round two to Thousand Knots! One each!
scene.grandline.ring_knots.end.1: narrator|Behind Ayame's tent, where the rope line runs into the long grass, you find it: an iron stake driven deep into the bedrock, the rope tied to it in a knot nobody could pull through.
scene.grandline.ring_knots.end.2: gunnar|...Three years. Three years I've guarded her flag because of a stake in the ground.
scene.grandline.ring_pledge.end.1: gunnar|She has announced the final. A duel in the Knot Ring, tomorrow. And she raised the stake: if you lose, she takes your flag AND my oath. For life.
scene.grandline.ring_pledge.end.2: gunnar|Her rope marks the ring. Her rope. You know what that means.
scene.grandline.ring_pledge.end.3: ayame|Sleep well! Tie your flag down tight — it'll come off easier!
scene.grandline.ring_choice.talk.1: gunnar|Two ways. One: you take that stake to the Tide Judge in front of the whole camp. He'll void every win she ever had. The herds go home. My oath goes back to the nomads.
scene.grandline.ring_choice.talk.2: gunnar|But she'll lose face in front of everyone, and a Supernova with no face left has nothing to lose. Her whole crew will come into the ring.
scene.grandline.ring_choice.talk.3: gunnar|Two: we say nothing. I pull the stake tonight. Tomorrow she fights fair without knowing it, and if you beat her, you beat her clean. She keeps her pride. She keeps the herds she 'won'.
scene.grandline.ring_choice.talk.4: gunnar|I'm a wall. Walls don't choose. You choose.
scene.grandline.choice.ring_plan.expose: Show the stake to the whole camp.
scene.grandline.choice.ring_plan.quiet: Say nothing. Gunnar pulls the stake tonight.
scene.grandline.ring_choice.end.expose.1: tide_judge|A STAKE? Three years of finals — on a STAKE? Every win of hers is void! The herds go home tonight!
scene.grandline.ring_choice.end.expose.2: ayame|...You. You little — CREW! Into the ring! All of you!
scene.grandline.ring_choice.end.quiet.1: gunnar|Hm. Tonight, then. Stand watch for me. Nobody comes near while I work.
scene.grandline.ring_expose.end.1: narrator|Ayame's crew goes down in the trampled grass. She stands alone in the Knot Ring with her whip coiled and her face burning.
scene.grandline.ring_expose.end.2: ayame|Fine. FINE. One on one. I don't need a stake to beat YOU.
scene.grandline.ring_quiet.end.1: narrator|Gunnar sets his hands round the stake and pulls. The bedrock groans. The stake comes up like a weed, and he lays it in the long grass where nobody will ever find it.
scene.grandline.ring_quiet.end.2: gunnar|Clean. Now it's just you and her.
scene.grandline.ring_final.start.1: tide_judge|The final round! In the Knot Ring! For the flag!
scene.grandline.ring_final.start.quiet.1: tide_judge|The final round! In the Knot Ring! For the flag — and the champion's oath!
scene.grandline.ring_final.start.quiet.2: ayame|Same rope as always. Same result as always. Pull, little captain.
scene.grandline.ring_final.end.1: narrator|Ayame goes down in the Knot Ring, and you hand the Long Ring flag straight back to the Tide Judge.
scene.grandline.ring_final.end.expose.1: narrator|Ayame goes down in the Knot Ring, and the whole camp is on its feet. The Tide Judge hands you the Long Ring flag; you hand it straight back to him, and the cheer doubles.
scene.grandline.ring_final.end.expose.2: tide_judge|The herds are home, the flag is ours and the champion is free. Long Ring Long Land won't forget it.
scene.grandline.ring_final.end.quiet.1: narrator|Ayame goes down in the Knot Ring. She stares at the rope, then at you — and then, slowly, she laughs.
scene.grandline.ring_final.end.quiet.2: ayame|You beat me. Clean. Nobody's done that. ...Here. My side bet, and my spare whip. Don't tie anything I wouldn't.
scene.grandline.ring_final.end.quiet.3: narrator|You hand the Long Ring flag to the Tide Judge. Gunnar watches you do it without a word.
scene.grandline.recruit_gunnar.start.1: gunnar|One more thing. On Long Ring, the winner shakes the loser's hand. Go on.
scene.grandline.recruit_gunnar.end.1: ayame|Hmph. Good grip. ...Next time I'll tie a better knot.
scene.grandline.recruit_gunnar.end.2: gunnar|The oath was to whoever holds the flag. The nomads hold it now. For the first time in my life I can choose who to stand behind.
scene.grandline.recruit_gunnar.end.3: gunnar|You fought fair. Fair is rare. Ask me, and I'll walk where you walk. The Log Pose points to Water 7, the city of ships.
scene.grandline.recruit_gunnar.end.expos: ayame|Good grip. Don't look so pleased. Everyone knows now, and I'll have to win the next one honestly. Ugh.
gunnar|The oath was to whoever holds the flag. The nomads hold it now. For the first time in my life I can choose who to stand behind.
gunnar|You fought fair. Fair is rare. Ask me, and I'll walk where you walk. The Log Pose points to Water 7, the city of ships.
scene.grandline.recruit_gunnar.end.quiet: ayame|Good grip. ...You knew, didn't you. About the stake. And you didn't say. Hmph. Then I owe you one. I hate owing.
gunnar|The oath was to whoever holds the flag. The nomads hold it now. For the first time in my life I can choose who to stand behind.
gunnar|You fought fair, and you let her keep her face. Fair is rare. Kind is rarer. Ask me, and I'll walk where you walk. The Log Pose points to Water 7.
recap.grandline.ring_1: Reached Long Ring Long Land and were challenged to the Tug-of-Tides by Ayame 'Thousand Knots' Musubi; the champion Gunnar would like her to lose, fairly.
recap.grandline.ring_round1: Won the first round, the Barrel Brawl.
recap.grandline.ring_knots: Lost the rope round and found out why: the rope was tied to an iron stake in the bedrock.
recap.grandline.ring_pledge: Ayame raised the stake for the final: your flag, and Gunnar's oath for life.
recap.grandline.ring_choice.expose: Decided to show the stake to the whole camp.
recap.grandline.ring_choice.quiet: Decided to say nothing and let Gunnar pull the stake at night.
recap.grandline.ring_expose: The Tide Judge voided her old wins; you beat the crew she sent into the ring.
recap.grandline.ring_quiet: Kept watch while Gunnar pulled the stake out of the bedrock.
recap.grandline.ring_final: Beat Ayame in the Knot Ring.
recap.grandline.ring_final.expose: Beat Ayame in the Knot Ring in front of the whole camp; the flag, the herds and the champion's oath went home to the nomads.
recap.grandline.ring_final.quiet: Beat Ayame in the Knot Ring, clean; she kept her pride and paid her side bet, and the flag went back to the nomads.
recap.grandline.recruit_gunnar: Shook Ayame's hand. Gunnar is free to choose who he stands behind, and will join if you ask. The Log Pose points to Water 7.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.bonus.expose: The nomads send you off with eight haunches of roast and the run of their markets: Long Ring Long Land's traders give you 15% off from now on.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.bonus.quiet: Ayame pays her side bet — and throws in her spare whip.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.aid.expose: The whole camp is chanting your name round the Knot Ring. You hit harder for it.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.aid.quiet: Gunnar stands at the edge of the Knot Ring like a wall. Nothing of hers gets past him to your back.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.during.gunnar: Hm. Stand behind me in the crowd. People step on newcomers here.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.during.ayame: Tie your flag on tight, newcomer. Tighter. No, tighter than that.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.after.gunnar: A free man doesn't need to talk more. But I could.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.after.ayame: You again. I've been practising knots. Different knots.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.after.ayame.e: Everyone watches my hands now. Do you know how hard it is to cheat with everyone watching? Very. I'm getting good at it anyway.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.after.ayame.q: I still owe you one. Don't spend it on anything stupid.
arc.grandline.tug_of_tides.after.townsfo: The champion's free and the flag's home. Even the grass tastes better this year — ask the horses.
A stake! Three years! The herds are home, and you've the run of the market, friend.
Thousand Knots lost fair and square! Never thought I'd see it.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.why: Water 7, the city of shipwrights, is about to tear itself apart: someone tried to put a spike through Guildmaster Hollis Kugiuchi's head, and every guild blames another. Most of all they blame the Dovetails — the guild the city banned years ago.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.cast.hollis: Guildmaster Hollis Kugiuchi, mayor of Water 7 and the best shipwright in it. Survived a spike to the head last week, and is cheerful about it.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.cast.kanna: Kanna 'the Mortise' Dovetail, a young shipwright of the banned Dovetail guild. Builds without nails, and in secret.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.cast.matthias: Matthias 'the Iron Abbot' Kanazuchi, a rival Supernova and warrior monk. Came for a ship; got a sermon's worth of trouble.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.cast.nimue: Nimue Kitsunebi, the Guildmaster's ever-so-helpful secretary.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.cast.brick: Brick Tsuchiya, foreman of the Guild's biggest yard. Hard hat zone.
arc.grandline.decision.water7_plan: what to do with the warship blueprints (talk to Hollis)
arc.grandline.site.water7_dovetail_yard: the Dovetail yard by the old docks
arc.grandline.site.water7_forge: the Guild's forge by the fountain
quest.grandline.water7_kanna.desc: Everyone says the Dovetails did it. The last Dovetail still building is Kanna, at the old yard by the docks. Talk to her.
quest.grandline.water7_matthias.desc: A rival captain, the monk Matthias, was at Guild headquarters on the night of the attack. Talk to him.
quest.grandline.water7_yard.desc: Hired raiders are setting fire to the Dovetail yard. Beat 5 of them before it all goes up.
quest.grandline.water7_choice.desc: Cipher Pol is after the blueprints of an ancient warship in Hollis's safe. Burn them, or let Kanna hide them? Talk to Hollis and decide.
quest.grandline.water7_burn.desc: Take the blueprints to the Guild's forge by the fountain with Hollis, and watch them burn.
quest.grandline.water7_hide.desc: Take the blueprints to Kanna's dry dock: she'll build them into a keel.
scene.grandline.water7_1.end.1: narrator|Water 7: a city built round a fountain, with canals for streets and shipyards for neighbourhoods. Three guild flags fly over three yards, and men with hammers glare at each other across every canal.
scene.grandline.water7_1.end.2: hollis|Welcome to Water 7! Need a ship? Everyone does. Mind the bandage — someone put a spike through my head last week. Missed the important bits.
scene.grandline.water7_1.end.3: hollis|Trouble is, the city's decided who did it. The Dovetails: a guild we banned years ago, after one of their keels sank a ship with forty souls aboard. The other two guilds want blood.
scene.grandline.water7_1.end.4: hollis|I don't believe it. Their last apprentice is still building down by the old docks, in secret. Go and talk to her before somebody with a torch does.
scene.grandline.water7_kanna.end.1: kanna|Don't touch that joint, it's drying. Kanna Dovetail. Yes, THAT Dovetail. If you've come to throw things, the rotten fruit's on the left.
scene.grandline.water7_kanna.end.2: kanna|We didn't sink that ship. My father proved the keel was cut — with a saw, after it left our yard. Nobody listened. Then Cipher Pol took him for 'questioning'. That was three years ago.
scene.grandline.water7_kanna.end.3: kanna|And now somebody tries to kill the Guildmaster and the whole city looks at me. Of course they do. If you want to know who really did it, ask the monk. He was there.
scene.grandline.water7_matthias.end.1: matthias|Peace be with you. Then a sermon. Then — oh, you only want to talk. How refreshing.
scene.grandline.water7_matthias.end.2: matthias|I was at Guild headquarters that night, ordering a ship. Something enormous with wings left the Guildmaster's window — a reptile, I'd swear, out of a picture book. And down in the foreman's yard, the earth stood up like a wall to hide a man.
scene.grandline.water7_matthias.end.3: matthias|Your attackers wore guild badges, rookie. They work for Hollis. They sleep in his building. Repent of your trust in office staff.
scene.grandline.water7_yard.start.1: narrator|Smoke over the old docks. Somebody is shouting 'DOVETAIL!' the way you'd shout 'thief'.
scene.grandline.water7_yard.end.1: narrator|The raiders go down in the smoke. Kanna's chains are already round the burning beams, hauling them clear.
scene.grandline.water7_yard.end.2: kanna|They were paid. Look — a pay slip from the foreman's office. Brick's yard.
scene.grandline.water7_yard.end.3: narrator|In another pocket, a note in very neat handwriting: 'The plans are in the Guildmaster's safe. Tonight, after the fire. — N.'
scene.grandline.water7_yard.end.4: kanna|N. Nimue. The secretary. ...The plans. They're after Hollis's plans.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.talk.1: hollis|So it's my own secretary and my own foreman. Cipher Pol. Well. I suppose that explains the spike.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.talk.2: hollis|They want these: the blueprints of an ancient warship that can sink an island. My old master copied them out of an older book, to build a weapon against it if one were ever built. He told me: if anyone comes for them, burn them.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.talk.3: hollis|My way: we take them to the forge by the fountain tonight and burn them. Nobody builds it. The whole Guild sees it done and stands with you when the agents come for revenge.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.talk.4: kanna|Or you give them to me. A ship's plans inside a ship — I'll build them into a keel nobody would ever think to cut open. They're only safe if they're gone. Or if they're moving.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.talk.5: kanna|Nobody would know but us. Not even the Guild. Which means nobody comes to help you when those two find out.
scene.grandline.choice.water7_plan.burn: Burn the blueprints in the forge.
scene.grandline.choice.water7_plan.hide: Let Kanna hide them in a keel.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.end.burn.1: hollis|Then it's the forge. Tonight. I'll bring the plans; you bring your fists.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.end.hide.1: kanna|My dry dock. Bring them after dark. Not a word to anyone — not even the Guildmaster's dog.
scene.grandline.water7_choice.end.hide.2: hollis|I didn't hear that. I'm the Guildmaster. I hear everything. ...I didn't hear that.
scene.grandline.water7_burn.end.1: narrator|The blueprints curl in the forge fire, a hundred years of ink gone in a moment. Behind you every shipwright of every guild has come to watch, hammers in hand.
scene.grandline.water7_burn.end.2: hollis|There. Nobody builds it, ever. And if two people in this crowd are about to try something stupid — the rest of us are watching.
scene.grandline.water7_hide.end.1: narrator|In the dark of the dry dock, Kanna slides the plans into a hollow in a keel timber and seals it with a joint so tight the wood looks grown that way.
scene.grandline.water7_hide.end.2: kanna|Done. Mortise, tenon, a bit of faith. Nobody will ever find them. ...Except you. You'll be standing on them.
scene.grandline.water7_2.start.1: nimue|Good evening! The Guildmaster is very busy. I'll take a message: your name, your crew, and where the blueprints are. Just for the files.
scene.grandline.water7_2.start.2: brick|Hard hat zone. You won't need one where you're going.
scene.grandline.water7_2.start.burn.1: nimue|You BURNED them? Do you have any idea how much paperwork that is?
scene.grandline.water7_2.start.burn.2: brick|Cipher Pol doesn't go home empty-handed. No plans, no Guildmaster.
scene.grandline.water7_2.start.hide.1: nimue|The safe is empty. Where are they? Tell me and I'll make it quick.
scene.grandline.water7_2.start.hide.2: brick|We'll take this city apart joint by joint until we find them.
scene.grandline.water7_2.end.1: narrator|The secretary and the foreman go down, and two Cipher Pol badges clatter onto the cobbles.
scene.grandline.water7_2.end.burn.1: narrator|The secretary and the foreman go down in front of the whole Guild. Two Cipher Pol badges clatter onto the cobbles, and three guilds are suddenly, loudly, on the same side.
scene.grandline.water7_2.end.burn.2: hollis|Well! I'll need a new secretary. And a foreman. And possibly an apology from about four hundred people to a girl at the old docks.
scene.grandline.water7_2.end.hide.1: narrator|The secretary and the foreman go down in an empty street. Nobody saw. Nobody knows what they were looking for but you, Kanna, and a keel timber that keeps its secret.
scene.grandline.water7_2.end.hide.2: kanna|Tough fight. Here — my grandfather's hammer. I don't need it; I've got chains. You need it more.
scene.grandline.water7_3.start.1: hollis|The Guild owes you a ship. A real refit. Kanna's doing it — I've lifted the ban. The Dovetails can build in Water 7 again.
scene.grandline.water7_3.end.1: kanna|She's holding together. Better than together. Every joint on her is mine now. ...Mostly. I've three new ideas for the keel, and only one of them explodes a little.
scene.grandline.water7_3.end.2: kanna|And Hollis has something to say to me. In public. I'd like you there.
scene.grandline.recruit_kanna.end.1: hollis|People of Water 7! The Dovetails did not sink that ship, and they did not try to kill me. Cipher Pol did. And we let them take Joiner Dovetail three years ago for asking questions. I'm sorry, Kanna.
scene.grandline.recruit_kanna.end.2: kanna|...Thank you. And — I'm leaving. Cipher Pol took my father to Enies Lobby, the island of law. Their last orders say everyone there goes 'through the Gates'. I'm going after him.
scene.grandline.recruit_kanna.end.3: kanna|A shipwright who never sails is just a carpenter with nice tools. Ask me to join, Captain. And then let's go and break a door.
recap.grandline.water7_1: Reached Water 7, where somebody tried to kill Guildmaster Hollis and the city blames the banned Dovetail guild.
recap.grandline.water7_kanna: Met Kanna Dovetail, building in secret: her father proved the fatal keel was cut, and Cipher Pol took him.
recap.grandline.water7_matthias: The monk Matthias saw the attackers: a winged beast at the Guildmaster's window, and earth rising to hide a man in the foreman's yard.
recap.grandline.water7_yard: Saved the Dovetail yard from raiders paid by the foreman's office; a note signed N. named the prize — Hollis's blueprints.
recap.grandline.water7_choice.burn: Decided to burn the warship blueprints.
recap.grandline.water7_choice.hide: Decided to let Kanna hide the blueprints in a keel.
recap.grandline.water7_burn: Burned the blueprints in the forge with every guild watching.
recap.grandline.water7_hide: Kanna sealed the blueprints inside a keel timber — under your feet.
recap.grandline.water7_2: Brought down the Cipher Pol agents: the secretary Nimue and the foreman Brick.
recap.grandline.water7_2.burn: Brought down the Cipher Pol agents Nimue and Brick, with all three guilds behind you.
recap.grandline.water7_2.hide: Brought down the Cipher Pol agents Nimue and Brick in an empty street; the plans' secret is safe.
recap.grandline.water7_3: The ban is lifted, and Kanna Dovetail refitted your ship.
recap.grandline.recruit_kanna: Hollis cleared the Dovetails' name in public. Kanna's father is in Enies Lobby; she'll join you if you ask, and go after him.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.bonus.burn: Every guild in Water 7 owes you now: the city's shipwrights and shops give you 15% off from now on.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.bonus.hide: Kanna gives you her grandfather's war hammer, and the Guildmaster quietly pays for 'some timber'.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.aid.burn: Shipwrights from all three guilds pour into the street behind you with hammers. You fight harder for it.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.during.hollis: Mind the bandage. And the secretary — no, she's lovely. Probably.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.during.kanna: If anyone asks, you're here about a hull.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.during.matthi: Repent, rookie. Or at least duck.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.after.hollis: Water 7 builds again — three guilds and a fourth. Need a ship? Everyone does.
I can still smell those plans burning. It smells like a good night's sleep.
What plans? I don't know about any plans. Lovely keel on your ship, by the way.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.after.kanna: She's holding together. I check every joint every night.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.after.matthia: You caught the sinners. I'll say a short prayer for them. Very short.
arc.grandline.three_guilds.after.townsfo: Cipher Pol! Inside the Guild! And the Dovetails innocent all along. I owe that girl a hammer.
I saw it myself — the plans in the forge and the whole Guild cheering. Anything you need, you'll get it cheap.
They say Cipher Pol tore the safe open and found nothing. Nobody knows where those plans went. Good.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.why: Cipher Pol has taken its prisoners to Enies Lobby, the island of law, to send them through the Gates of Justice at dawn — Kanna's father, Joiner Dovetail, among them. And Director Hanzaki has asked for a Buster Call 'to tidy up'.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.cast.nimb: Nimbus 'Ninefold' Kasumi, a CP9 trainee with the Fog-Fog Fruit, ordered to guard the prisoners — and to fire on them if anyone tries to free them.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.cast.kann: Kanna Dovetail, here for her father.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.cast.greg: Gregor 'Iron Jury' Hanzaki, Director of CP9, with the Needle-Needle Fruit. No trial, no appeal, no exit.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.cast.dmit: Vice Admiral Dmitri Kawaragi, 'the Buster', commanding the fleet off the island. Has carried out four Buster Calls. Sleeps fine. Mostly.
arc.grandline.decision.enies_plan: the tower or the convoy (talk to Nimbus)
arc.grandline.site.enies_front_gate: the main gate of Enies Lobby
arc.grandline.site.enies_tower_stairs: the stairs of the Tower of Justice
arc.grandline.site.enies_convoy: the prisoner convoy at the Gates
quest.grandline.enies_nimbus.desc: One of the prisoners' guards — a trainee called Nimbus — let you walk right past her. Talk to her.
quest.grandline.enies_buster.desc: Ships on the horizon: ten battleships, ten vice admirals. Get to the Bridge of Hesitation before the convoy crosses it.
quest.grandline.enies_choice.desc: The convoy goes through the Gates at dawn; Hanzaki is in the tower with the keys and the order. Talk to Nimbus and decide which comes first.
quest.grandline.enies_tower.desc: Fight up the stairs of the Tower of Justice: beat 3 agents.
quest.grandline.enies_convoy.desc: Stop the prisoner convoy at the Gates with Nimbus: beat its 3 guards.
scene.grandline.enies_1.start.1: kanna|That's it. Enies Lobby. My father's somewhere in there. ...I'm fine. I'm fine. Let's go and knock.
scene.grandline.enies_1.end.1: narrator|The gate's agents go down, and you're through into the island of law: a courthouse, a tower, and beyond them a pair of gates the size of a mountain, standing open on a whirlpool.
scene.grandline.enies_1.end.2: narrator|At the foot of the tower a young woman in a CP9 suit stands guard over a line of shackled prisoners. She sees you. She opens her mouth to raise the alarm — and doesn't.
scene.grandline.enies_1.marine.start.1: dmitri|You're the new one assigned to my fleet. Good. Pirates are trying to reach the tower before the transfer. Stop them. Ask no questions; you won't like the answers.
scene.grandline.enies_1.marine.end.1: narrator|The pirates on the pier go down. Up by the tower a CP9 trainee stands over a line of prisoners — clerks, a carpenter, an old man with sawdust in his beard — looking at them as if they were people.
scene.grandline.enies_nimbus.end.1: nimbus|You shouldn't be here. I'm supposed to stop you. I've been trained since I was eight to stop people like you. ...Why aren't I stopping you?
scene.grandline.enies_nimbus.end.2: nimbus|Nimbus. Trainee. These prisoners go through the Gates at dawn, to Impel Down. The old carpenter is Joiner Dovetail. Three years, and he's never said a word to them.
scene.grandline.enies_nimbus.end.3: joiner|Kanna? Kanna, you idiot child — you came HERE?
scene.grandline.enies_nimbus.end.4: nimbus|And there's more. The Director has asked for a Buster Call. Ten battleships, to shell the island flat 'to tidy up' — with the clerks still in the courthouse. My orders are to shoot the prisoners if anyone tries to free them. ...I don't think I can.
scene.grandline.enies_buster.start.1: den_den|Puru puru puru... This is Vice Admiral Kawaragi. Buster Call authorised. All ships, close on Enies Lobby. Leave nothing standing.
scene.grandline.enies_buster.end.1: narrator|From the Bridge of Hesitation you can see it all: the fleet closing, the convoy forming up at the foot of the tower, and the Director at the top window, watching like a man at a play.
scene.grandline.enies_buster.end.2: nimbus|We can't do both. Not before the shells start.
scene.grandline.enies_choice.talk.1: nimbus|One: go up the tower now. Hanzaki has the shackle keys and the only den den mushi that can call off the fleet. I'll hold the convoy at the Gates alone. In fog. I'm good in fog.
scene.grandline.enies_choice.talk.2: nimbus|Alone, with my own squad guarding it. They'll know I've turned. ...I'll manage.
scene.grandline.enies_choice.talk.3: nimbus|Two: we stop the convoy together, first. The prisoners are safe in minutes. But Hanzaki gets time — and he'll use it to start the Buster Call before you reach him.
scene.grandline.enies_choice.talk.4: kanna|Get my father out. ...No. Do what's right. He'd say the same, and then hit me with a ruler.
scene.grandline.choice.enies_plan.tower: Go up the tower for Hanzaki now. Nimbus holds the convoy.
scene.grandline.choice.enies_plan.convoy: Stop the convoy with Nimbus first.
scene.grandline.enies_choice.end.tower.1: nimbus|Then go. Don't look back — you won't see me anyway.
nimbus|Together, then. Stay close in the fog. Closer. That's my foot.
scene.grandline.enies_tower.end.1: narrator|The agents on the stairs go down, one landing at a time. Far below, the Gates vanish into a fog bank that wasn't there a minute ago.
scene.grandline.enies_convoy.end.1: narrator|The convoy's guards go down at the edge of the whirlpool. Nimbus's fog rolls over the line of prisoners as Kanna's anchor chain snaps their shackles one after another.
scene.grandline.enies_convoy.end.2: joiner|Kanna. My girl. Your joints are sloppy. ...I've never been so proud.
scene.grandline.enies_convoy.end.3: den_den|Puru puru... Buster Call commencing. All ships, fire.
scene.grandline.enies_2.start.1: gregor|On this island there is no trial, no appeal and no exit. I am the jury. I have reached my verdict.
scene.grandline.enies_2.start.tower.1: gregor|You came up my stairs. Nobody comes up my stairs. The trainee has betrayed us, I see — the Gates are full of fog. Never mind. I'll sentence her after you.
scene.grandline.enies_2.start.convoy.1: gregor|You saved the prisoners. How touching. Listen — those are the shells. The island burns in ten minutes, and you with it. I'll enjoy the last nine.
scene.grandline.enies_2.end.1: narrator|Iron Jury goes down on the floor of his own courtroom.
scene.grandline.enies_2.end.tower.1: narrator|Iron Jury goes down on the floor of his own courtroom. You take the shackle keys from his belt and the den den mushi from his desk; the fleet hears the Director's own channel call it off, and the shelling stops before it starts.
scene.grandline.enies_2.end.tower.2: nimbus|(through the fog) Convoy held! I'm... fine. Mostly. My old squad hits hard.
scene.grandline.enies_2.end.convoy.1: narrator|Iron Jury goes down on the floor of his courtroom as the first shells hit the courthouse. The prisoners are already aboard your ship. Now you just have to get there.
scene.grandline.enies_2.marine.start.1: dmitri|The order's come. Buster Call. All ships fire on my signal. ...You have a question, recruit? Ask it quickly.
scene.grandline.enies_2.marine.end.1: narrator|You hold the pier while the clerks and the prisoners file onto the last ship out. The trainee Nimbus walks beside them in a fog of her own making.
scene.grandline.enies_2.marine.end.2: dmitri|You evacuated them against my order. ...Good. Write it in your report exactly like that. I'll sign it.
scene.grandline.enies_3.start.1: narrator|The Buster Call falls on Enies Lobby. Shells walk across the island from the sea, and between you and your ship is a line of Marines with orders to let nothing off it.
scene.grandline.enies_3.start.tower.1: narrator|The shelling has stopped, but the fleet hasn't left: Vice Admiral Kawaragi doesn't take orders from a voice he can't see. Between you and your ship is a line of Marines.
scene.grandline.enies_3.end.1: narrator|You break through the line, and the ship pulls away from a burning island. Kanna's father sits on the deck staring at the sky as if he'd forgotten it was there.
scene.grandline.enies_3.end.tower.1: narrator|You break through the line, and the ship pulls away from an island still standing. Kanna's father sits on the deck staring at the sky as if he'd forgotten it was there.
scene.grandline.enies_3.marine.start.1: dmitri|Pirates are looting the courthouse while it's empty. Clear them. And recruit — well done.
scene.grandline.enies_3.marine.end.1: narrator|The looters are cleared from the courthouse. Vice Admiral Kawaragi stands at the rail of his flagship for a long time without saying anything.
scene.grandline.recruit_nimbus.start.1: nimbus|They're following us. My old squad. Two of them. Of course they are. I'd follow me.
scene.grandline.recruit_nimbus.end.1: nimbus|...That's it, then. I'm a traitor to the World Government. Eight years of training to vanish, and nowhere to vanish to.
scene.grandline.recruit_nimbus.end.2: nimbus|Unless. You taught me there was somewhere worth reappearing. If you'll have me — I can fog a compass, open a lock and lie to an admiral. Ask me.
scene.grandline.recruit_nimbus.end.3: kanna|And my father says thank you. He said it twice. He has never said anything twice.
scene.grandline.recruit_nimbus.end.4: nimbus|The Log Pose points to Thriller Bark. Fog and graves. I'll feel right at home.
scene.grandline.recruit_nimbus.end.tower: nimbus|...That's it, then. They saw me hold the Gates against them. I'm a traitor to the World Government, with a bruise the shape of my old instructor's knee.
nimbus|Unless. You taught me there was somewhere worth reappearing. If you'll have me — I can fog a compass, open a lock and lie to an admiral. Ask me.
kanna|And my father says thank you. He said it twice. He has never said anything twice.
nimbus|The Log Pose points to Thriller Bark. Fog and graves. I'll feel right at home.
recap.grandline.enies_1: Stormed the gate of Enies Lobby, the island of law, where Cipher Pol keeps its prisoners.
recap.grandline.enies_nimbus: The CP9 trainee Nimbus let you past: Kanna's father is among the prisoners, the convoy leaves at dawn, and Director Hanzaki has asked for a Buster Call.
recap.grandline.enies_buster: Reached the Bridge of Hesitation as the Buster Call fleet closed in.
recap.grandline.enies_choice.tower: Decided to go up the tower for Hanzaki while Nimbus held the convoy alone.
recap.grandline.enies_choice.convoy: Decided to stop the prisoner convoy with Nimbus first.
recap.grandline.enies_tower: Fought up the stairs of the Tower of Justice.
recap.grandline.enies_convoy: Stopped the convoy at the Gates; Kanna broke her father's shackles.
recap.grandline.enies_2: Brought down Director Gregor 'Iron Jury' Hanzaki.
recap.grandline.enies_2.tower: Brought down Director Hanzaki and called off the Buster Call with his own den den mushi.
recap.grandline.enies_2.convoy: Brought down Director Hanzaki as the Buster Call began.
recap.grandline.enies_3: Got off Enies Lobby as the island burned.
recap.grandline.enies_3.tower: Got off Enies Lobby through Kawaragi's line; the island still stands.
recap.grandline.recruit_nimbus: Beat Nimbus's old squad. She has nowhere to vanish to, and will join you if you ask. The Log Pose points to Thriller Bark.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.bonus.tow: Hanzaki's strongbox and his spare seastone cuffs come with you: 10,000 Beli of Cipher Pol's money.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.bonus.con: The freed prisoners carry the story home — the clerks, the carpenters, and Joiner Dovetail, who sails back to Water 7 a free man. (Reputation with civilians and with Water 7.)
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.bonus.kee: 'Where... are the plans?' were the Director's last words before he went down. Nimbus laughs for the first time when you tell her — and teaches you the Rokushiki form she swore she'd never teach anyone.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.aid.tower: Down below, the prisoners are rattling their chains in time. It goes through you like a war drum.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.aid.convo: Nimbus's fog fills the courtroom. Hanzaki's needles find nothing but mist.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.during.ni: Don't look at me. I'm not here. I'm a cloud.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.during.ka: My father's in that tower. I can feel every joint of it.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.during.dm: Ten battleships, ten vice admirals, one order. Stay out of the line of fire.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.after.nim: Nobody followed us. Two people tried. I fogged their compasses.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.after.kan: He's home in Water 7. He's grumpy. It's wonderful.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.after.dmi: Four Buster Calls. Five, now. I don't sleep as well as I used to.
The Director called it off on his own channel. Strange — his voice sounded younger than I remembered. I didn't ask.
arc.grandline.gates_of_justice.after.mar: Don't ask about the Director. Nobody's allowed to ask about the Director.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.why: A fog-bound island drifts in the dark sea, and every sailor who passes it loses their reflection: the Warlord Countess Lucrezia Kagamiya keeps them in her mirrors and makes them into soldiers.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.cast.mortime: Mortimer 'the Gravedigger' Hakaba, a rival Supernova with the Hollow-Hollow Fruit and an anchor-shovel. His whole crew lost their reflections.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.cast.lucrezi: Countess Lucrezia Kagamiya, a Warlord of the Sea with the Mirror-Mirror Fruit. Finds your reflection lovely. Wants it on her wall.
arc.grandline.decision.thriller_plan: how to reach the Countess (talk to Mortimer)
quest.grandline.thriller_soldiers.desc: Soldiers with sailors' faces and no shadows march out of the graveyard. Shatter 6 of them.
quest.grandline.thriller_mirrors.desc: Every stolen reflection is kept somewhere. Find the Countess's hall of mirrors.
quest.grandline.thriller_dawn.desc: One face in the mirrors is yours. Talk to Mortimer.
quest.grandline.thriller_choice.desc: Mortimer knows two ways to the Countess. Talk to him and decide.
quest.grandline.thriller_crypt.desc: Dig in under the graveyard with Mortimer and beat the 3 oldest soldiers guarding her crypt.
quest.grandline.thriller_gate.desc: Walk up to the mansion's front gate at first light, where every sailor on the island can see you.
quest.grandline.thriller_3.desc: The fog is lifting. Talk to Mortimer before he digs his crew back out to sea.
scene.grandline.thriller_1.end.1: narrator|Thriller Bark: an island wrapped in fog so thick it drips, a mansion on the hill and a graveyard all the way down to the shore. The water in the harbour is perfectly still. You look into it. Nothing looks back.
scene.grandline.thriller_1.end.2: mortimer|Lost yours already? Fast. It took mine a whole afternoon. Mortimer Hakaba. Gravedigger. Rival, technically. Every ship sinks eventually — I just like to be there with a shovel.
scene.grandline.thriller_1.end.3: mortimer|The Countess up the hill takes reflections. Keeps them in her mirrors, dresses them up and sends them marching. My whole crew's out there somewhere in her army. With my face, in one case. Not my best side.
narrator|Out of the graveyard fog comes a line of soldiers: sailors' faces, sailors' clothes, and not one of them casts a shadow.
scene.grandline.thriller_soldiers.end.1: narrator|The soldiers shatter like glass when they fall, and from each one a faint shape rises and drifts away over the hill — back toward the mansion.
scene.grandline.thriller_soldiers.end.2: mortimer|They go back to her mirrors. Every one. You can't kill a reflection; you can only send it home. And home is her wall.
scene.grandline.thriller_mirrors.end.1: narrator|The hall of mirrors runs the length of the mansion: a thousand frames, and in every one a face that isn't yours, pressing at the glass from the inside.
scene.grandline.thriller_mirrors.end.2: narrator|In the biggest frame, at the end, is one that is. Your reflection, looking back at you for the first time since the fog.
scene.grandline.thriller_mirrors.end.3: lost_sailor|(from inside a mirror) Till dawn! At dawn she sails, and whoever's still in a mirror stays in it!
scene.grandline.thriller_dawn.end.1: mortimer|So she has yours too. Good. Now you'll take it personally.
scene.grandline.thriller_dawn.end.2: mortimer|At dawn she casts off, and the whole island goes with her. Anyone without a reflection when she does stays without. Forever. My crew's been without for a month. I'd like them back before I bury anyone.
scene.grandline.thriller_choice.talk.1: mortimer|Two ways in. My way: under. I dug half this graveyard while I was waiting. There's a crypt under her mansion and a passage into it, and we come up behind her. Her oldest soldiers guard it, though. They've been dead a long time and they're bad-tempered.
scene.grandline.thriller_choice.talk.2: mortimer|Or the gate. Walk up the hill at first light, through the front door, loud. Every sailor without a reflection is hiding in this fog. If they see someone go in, they'll follow. Can't fight much. Can stand behind you.
scene.grandline.thriller_choice.talk.3: mortimer|A surprise, or a crowd. I'd dig, personally. But then I would. I'm a gravedigger.
scene.grandline.choice.thriller_plan.gra: Mortimer's way: under the graves, into her crypt.
scene.grandline.choice.thriller_plan.fro: The front gate at first light, where everyone can see.
scene.grandline.thriller_choice.end.grav: mortimer|Ha. Bring a lamp. Don't touch the walls; some of them touch back.
scene.grandline.thriller_choice.end.fron: mortimer|Loud, then. I'll ring a bell. Graveyards have plenty.
scene.grandline.thriller_crypt.end.1: narrator|The crypt's guards fall into dust and mirror-glass. Mortimer puts his shoulder to the ceiling and it lifts — straight into the Countess's dressing room.
scene.grandline.thriller_gate.end.1: narrator|You walk up the hill at first light, and out of the fog, one by one, come the sailors without reflections — dozens of them, with boat hooks and oars. By the time you reach the gate there are a hundred at your back.
scene.grandline.thriller_gate.end.2: lost_sailor|We can't fight her. But we can stand here. We'll stand right here.
scene.grandline.thriller_2.start.1: lucrezia|Oh, what a lovely reflection you have. It would look so much better on my wall. Hold still, darling, and smile.
lucrezia|In my DRESSING ROOM? Through the FLOOR? Darling, you're filthy. Hold still and I'll wipe you off a mirror.
scene.grandline.thriller_2.start.front.1: lucrezia|A crowd? At my gate? How common. Never mind, darling — a hundred more reflections for my wall.
scene.grandline.thriller_2.end.1: narrator|The Countess goes down among her mirrors, and every mirror in the mansion cracks at once. A thousand reflections pour out of the glass like birds and fly home. You look into a cracked mirror, and you look back.
scene.grandline.thriller_2.end.graves.1: narrator|The Countess goes down among her mirrors, and every mirror in the mansion cracks at once. A thousand reflections pour out of the glass like birds and fly home.
scene.grandline.thriller_2.end.graves.2: mortimer|There's my face. Ugly as ever. And my crew's. ...And something else, in the crypt behind her coffin: a sea chest. I think you've earned half.
scene.grandline.thriller_2.end.front.1: narrator|The Countess goes down among her mirrors, and every mirror in the mansion cracks at once. Out in the courtyard a hundred sailors look down at a puddle, a hundred faces look back up, and the cheer could wake the graveyard.
scene.grandline.thriller_3.start.1: narrator|The fog is lifting off Thriller Bark for the first time in years. Mortimer leans on his shovel by the harbour, watching his crew admire themselves in the water.
scene.grandline.thriller_3.end.1: mortimer|You didn't have to come up that hill. Most rivals would've left me in the fog. Fewer rivals that way.
scene.grandline.thriller_3.end.2: mortimer|I'll see you at Sabaody, then. Everyone's going: every rookie with a bounty and an ego. The Fence's auction is something to see, they say. Not in a good way.
scene.grandline.thriller_3.end.3: mortimer|If you ever sink, I'll dig you a lovely hole. Best in the business. That's a compliment.
recap.grandline.thriller_1: Reached Thriller Bark, where the fog steals reflections, and met the gravedigger Mortimer, whose crew lost theirs.
recap.grandline.thriller_soldiers: Shattered the reflection soldiers in the graveyard; every one flew back to the Countess's mirrors.
recap.grandline.thriller_mirrors: Found the hall of mirrors — and your own reflection in the biggest frame.
recap.grandline.thriller_dawn: Learned that at dawn the Countess sails, and whoever is still in a mirror then stays there.
recap.grandline.thriller_choice.graves: Decided to dig under the graves into the Countess's crypt with Mortimer.
recap.grandline.thriller_choice.front: Decided to walk in through the front gate at first light.
recap.grandline.thriller_crypt: Fought through the crypt's oldest soldiers and came up through her floor.
recap.grandline.thriller_gate: Walked up the hill at dawn with a hundred sailors without reflections behind you.
recap.grandline.thriller_2: Brought down the Warlord Countess Kagamiya; every reflection went home.
recap.grandline.thriller_2.graves: Brought down the Countess in her own dressing room; every reflection went home, and Mortimer found her sea chest.
recap.grandline.thriller_2.front: Brought down the Countess with a hundred sailors at the gate; every reflection went home.
recap.grandline.thriller_3: The fog lifted. Mortimer will see you at Sabaody, where every rookie is headed.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.bonus.graves: Mortimer splits the Countess's sea chest with you: 5,000 Beli and one of his spare anchor-shovels.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.bonus.front: A hundred sailors carry the story to every port in Paradise: the rookie who walked in through the Countess's front door. (Reputation with civilians and pirates.)
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.aid.graves: You come up through the floor behind her before she can raise a mirror. You strike first, and hard.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.aid.front: A hundred sailors fill the courtyard behind you. Her soldiers can't get round them to your back.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.during.morti: Mind the graves. Some are mine. Some will be.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.during.lucre: Such a lovely face, darling. Do stand closer to the glass.
arc.grandline.mirror_monger.after.mortim: Every ship sinks eventually. Not yours, though. Not yet.
Best digging I've done in years. Want the crypt? No? Shame. Nice crypt.
A hundred sailors at the gate. I rang the bell for them. Never heard a bell sound that good.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.why: Every rookie crew in the world has reached Sabaody at once, and tomorrow the Fence's auction house sells a Mink cub and Coralie's sister to a World Noble. The bubble-coater Ume needs three days to make your ship ready for the deep.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.cast.ume: Ume Shabondama, the old bubble-coater who coated the Saltfire King's ship for the deep. Inspects every hull as if it owed her money.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.cast.cora: Coralie 'Riptide Diva' Utahime, a merfolk Supernova who sings while she fights. Her sister Marina is lot forty-seven.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.cast.edis: Edison 'Professor Sparks' Haguruma, a three-eyed Supernova inventor. Has a button for everything. Don't press it.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.cast.augu: Augustin 'Gavel' Rakusatsu, the Fence's auctioneer. Everything has a price; everyone is for sale.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.cast.pomp: Saint Pompadour Gildenstern, a World Noble in a bubble helmet. Buys people. Shoots people who breathe his air.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.cast.zeni: Admiral Tenma 'Zenith' Solberg of the Glint-Glint Fruit, who lands wherever a World Noble complains.
arc.grandline.decision.sabaody_plan: how to free the captives (talk to Coralie)
arc.grandline.site.sabaody_catchers: the slave-catchers' camp in the groves
arc.grandline.site.sabaody_rioters: the riot outside the auction house
arc.grandline.site.sabaody_admiral_landi: the Admiral's landing at the docks
quest.grandline.sabaody_ume.desc: Ume the bubble-coater can coat your ship for the deep — if you can wait. Talk to her.
quest.grandline.sabaody_catchers.desc: Slave-catchers work the groves for the auction house. Beat 5 of them.
quest.grandline.sabaody_auction.desc: The auction opens at noon. Go to the auction house.
quest.grandline.sabaody_choice.desc: Coralie's sister is on the block. Break her out by force, or buy her back? Talk to Coralie and decide.
quest.grandline.sabaody_riot.desc: Storm the auction floor: beat 4 of the guards between you and the stage.
quest.grandline.sabaody_bid.desc: Edison has prize money and Coralie has concert takings. Talk to them both and put the bid together.
scene.grandline.sabaody_1.end.1: narrator|Sabaody Archipelago: mangroves so huge the islands are their roots, and bubbles drifting up out of the ground wherever you look. Every rookie crew in the world seems to be here, drinking and glaring.
scene.grandline.sabaody_1.end.2: coralie|La la laaa — oh! A rival! Rivals make the best audiences. Coralie Utahime. You've heard me sing? No? You will. Everyone will. At my sister's homecoming.
scene.grandline.sabaody_1.end.3: edison|Fascinating! Your stance, your bone density, your obviously poor impulse control. Edison Haguruma. Hold this. Don't press the red button. ...You pressed it.
scene.grandline.sabaody_1.end.4: narrator|Somewhere above you, a small explosion. Edison writes something down.
scene.grandline.sabaody_ume.end.1: ume|You want a coating? For the deep? Let's see your hull. Hm. Hmmm. Who did these joints? Good. Three days, and don't rush me.
scene.grandline.sabaody_ume.end.2: ume|Three days is a long time on Sabaody. Every captain with a bounty is here, the Marines are nervous, and tomorrow the Fence holds his auction. People, love. He sells people. There's a World Noble in town to buy.
scene.grandline.sabaody_ume.end.3: coralie|My sister is lot forty-seven. Marina. The catchers took her from Mermaid Cove a month ago. I'm going to get her back. I'd like an audience.
scene.grandline.sabaody_catchers.end.1: narrator|The catchers go down in the grove. Their camp is full of empty collars, and their papers carry a CP0 stamp.
scene.grandline.sabaody_catchers.end.2: narrator|And a note: 'Thanks again to our friend the Miasma for the tip. His information is always good.'
scene.grandline.sabaody_catchers.end.3: edison|The Miasma. Nox Tsukuyomi: rival rookie, Gas-Gas Fruit, everyone's friend. I've never trusted a man who's everyone's friend. Hypothesis: he's nobody's.
scene.grandline.sabaody_auction.end.1: narrator|The auction house is full: pirates, merchants, nobles in bubble helmets. In the front row a World Noble in a fishbowl is shooting at the ceiling to show he's bored.
scene.grandline.sabaody_auction.end.2: pompadour|Ugh, you're breathing MY air. Hurry up, auctioneer! I want the fish and the cat!
scene.grandline.sabaody_auction.end.3: augustin|Lots forty-six and forty-seven, Your Worship, the finest of the evening! A Mink cub, and a mermaid who sings! Do I hear a hundred million?
scene.grandline.sabaody_auction.end.4: marina|Coralie! Don't — don't do anything stupid!
scene.grandline.sabaody_auction.end.5: coralie|...Too late. Captain? I'm about to do something stupid. Want to help?
scene.grandline.sabaody_choice.talk.1: coralie|One: we go over the seats and take them. Now. The guards, the auctioneer — and if that fishbowl gets in the way, he gets in the way.
scene.grandline.sabaody_choice.talk.2: edison|You do understand that punching a World Noble brings an Admiral. Not 'might'. Does. Statistically, always.
scene.grandline.sabaody_choice.talk.3: coralie|Two: we buy them. Edison has his prize money, I have a month of concert takings, and you have a bounty's worth of nerve. We outbid the fishbowl, walk them out, and cut the collars in the street.
scene.grandline.sabaody_choice.talk.4: edison|The auctioneer will never let a Noble lose. He'll cheat. When he does, there'll be a fight anyway — just a smaller one.
scene.grandline.sabaody_choice.talk.5: coralie|Your call, Captain. Quickly. He's at ninety million.
scene.grandline.choice.sabaody_plan.punc: Over the seats: break them out by force.
scene.grandline.choice.sabaody_plan.buy: Buy them back, then cut the collars outside.
scene.grandline.sabaody_choice.end.punch: edison|I'll be over here. Taking notes. Mostly from under the seats.
scene.grandline.sabaody_choice.end.buy.1: edison|Prize money. Here. I was saving it for a rocket. Sisters are better than rockets. Probably.
scene.grandline.sabaody_riot.end.1: narrator|You go over the seats. The guards go down, the stage comes up, and somewhere in the chaos a World Noble in a fishbowl is punched clean across the auction floor. Afterwards, everyone in the room will claim they did it.
scene.grandline.sabaody_riot.end.2: pompadour|You — you STRUCK me? I'll have an ADMIRAL here! I'll have ALL the admirals!
scene.grandline.sabaody_bid.end.1: narrator|Edison's prize money, Coralie's takings, and a figure that makes the auctioneer's eyebrows climb: ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY MILLION. The room gasps. The Noble splutters into his fishbowl.
scene.grandline.sabaody_bid.end.2: augustin|Sold to — no. NO. Lots withdrawn! Withdrawn by the house! Guards!
scene.grandline.sabaody_bid.end.3: coralie|He's cheating. Of course he's cheating.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.start.1: augustin|Everything has a price. Everyone is for sale. You there — are you buying, or for sale?
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.start.punch.1: augustin|You've ruined my auction! I'll sell you for parts, by the pound!
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.start.buy.1: augustin|A fair bid? In MY house? The house always wins, children. Guards — take them all, the buyers too!
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.end.1: narrator|Gavel goes down on his own stage, and Coralie gets to the collars first.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.end.punch.1: narrator|Gavel goes down on his own stage. Coralie tears the collar off her sister with her bare hands, and the Mink cub, collar off, bites the nearest guard on principle.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.end.punch.2: marina|You idiot. You wonderful idiot. You hit a World Noble.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.end.punch.3: coralie|I didn't. Did I? Someone did. Everyone did.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.end.buy.1: narrator|Gavel goes down on his own stage. Out in the street Edison cuts the collars with something that whirrs and sparks, while the Noble demands his money back from an empty stage.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.end.buy.2: marina|You bought me. With concert money. I'm never going to hear the end of this.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.marine.start.1: zenith|Ahh, escort duty. So bright today. Keep the Saint happy, recruit, and keep the rioters away from him. And try not to listen to him — I find it helps.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.marine.end.1: narrator|The riot breaks around you, and in the chaos the auction lots are gone — the mermaid, the Mink cub, a dozen others — and nobody saw who took them. Admiral Zenith looks very hard at nothing at all.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.marine.end.2: zenith|Such a shame. They must have escaped. Write that down, recruit. Escaped.
scene.grandline.sabaody_2.civilian.end.1: narrator|The captives walk out of the back door while the guards are busy with the troublemakers you kept away. Ume pours tea for everyone. Nobody punched anybody. Coralie is slightly disappointed.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.start.1: narrator|A flash of light over the groves: an Admiral has landed. And on every den den mushi on Sabaody, the same broadcast.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.start.2: den_den|By order of the World Government: Haruka 'the Lamplighter' Lanthorn, navigator of the Saltfire King, has been captured. She will be executed in public at Marineford.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.start.3: edison|The Miasma's tip. He sold her hiding place. I'd bet my third eye on it.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.end.1: narrator|You break through the Marine line to Ume's yard. Your ship sits wrapped in a shining bubble, ready for the deep.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.end.2: ume|Done, and two days early, because SOMEONE brought an Admiral down on my head. Go on: down to Fish-Man Island if you want the deep road — or into the Calm Belt, if you mean to go after the Lamplighter.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.end.3: ume|...I coated her ship once, too. Haruka. A long time ago. Bring her back, if anyone can.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.marine.start.1: zenith|The Lamplighter's captured. The transfer is in an hour. Clear the groves, recruit — every pirate on Sabaody wants to be a hero today.
scene.grandline.sabaody_3.marine.end.1: narrator|The groves are clear. Out at sea a convoy sails for Marineford with the last person alive who has seen the final island. Admiral Zenith watches it go without a word.
recap.grandline.sabaody_1: Reached Sabaody, where every rookie crew in the world has gathered, and met the rivals Coralie and Edison.
recap.grandline.sabaody_ume: Ume will coat your ship for the deep in three days — and tomorrow the auction sells Coralie's sister.
recap.grandline.sabaody_catchers: Broke the slave-catchers in the groves; their papers thank 'the Miasma' for his tips.
recap.grandline.sabaody_auction: At the auction a World Noble bid for lots forty-six and forty-seven: a Mink cub and Coralie's sister Marina.
recap.grandline.sabaody_choice.punch: Decided to break the captives out by force.
recap.grandline.sabaody_choice.buy: Decided to buy the captives back with the crews' pooled money.
recap.grandline.sabaody_riot: Went over the seats; somebody punched a World Noble across the auction floor.
recap.grandline.sabaody_bid: Outbid the World Noble — and the auctioneer withdrew the lots.
recap.grandline.sabaody_2: Brought down Gavel the auctioneer; the captives are free.
recap.grandline.sabaody_2.punch: Brought down Gavel on his own stage; Coralie tore her sister's collar off with her bare hands.
recap.grandline.sabaody_2.buy: Brought down Gavel when he cheated; Edison cut the collars in the street.
recap.grandline.sabaody_3: An Admiral landed, and the World Government announced the Lamplighter's execution at Marineford. Ume finished your coating.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.bonus.pun: Everyone on Sabaody claims they punched the Noble. The pirates and the Revolutionaries know better. (Reputation with pirates and Revolutionaries.)
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.bonus.buy: Sabaody's honest traders heard what you did with the money: they give you 15% off from now on.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.aid.punch: Coralie sings and Edison's inventions go off all round the stage. You fight with a rival on each side.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.aid.buy: Marina sings from the edge of the stage, a mermaid's song, and the blows that reach you land soft.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.during.um: Three days. Don't rush me. And don't bring trouble to my yard.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.during.co: Lot forty-seven. I count it like a song.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.during.ed: Hold this. No, the other end.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.after.ume: Your coating's holding. Of course it is. I did it.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.after.cor: Marina sends her love, and a list of complaints.
Somebody punched a World Noble. I'm telling everyone it was me. You can tell everyone it was you.
A month of takings, gone on one sister. Best concert I ever gave.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.after.edi: Hypothesis confirmed: you have terrible impulse control. Excellent.
The fishbowl went eleven metres. I measured.
I'll build the rocket next year. Sisters first.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.after.tow: The auction house is closed. Boarded up. Somebody wrote SOLD across the door.
Did you hear? Somebody punched a World Noble! Everyone says they did it. Was it you?
They bought the poor things back, the house cheated, and the house STILL lost! For you — the good price.
arc.grandline.auction_of_souls.after.mar: Nobody saw anything at the auction house. Admiral's orders.
